templates.pattern: A machine does [W] J of work in [T] seconds. What is its power output?
A [P] W motor runs for [T] seconds. How much energy does it transfer?
A device transfers [EU] J of useful energy from [ET] J of total input energy. What is its efficiency as a percentage?
templates.explanation: Efficiency = (Useful Energy Output ÷ Total Energy Input) × 100 = ([EU] ÷ [ET]) × 100 = [RESULT]%

templates.pattern: An object of mass [M] kg is lifted [H] m vertically. How much gravitational potential energy does it gain? (g = 10 m/s²)
An object of mass [M] kg moves at [V] m/s. What is its kinetic energy?
A [P] W appliance is used for [H] hours. How many kilowatt-hours (kWh) of energy does it use?
A ball of mass [M] kg is dropped from a height of [H] m. Assuming no energy loss, what is its kinetic energy just before hitting the ground? (g = 10 m/s²)
templates.explanation: By conservation of energy, KE at bottom = GPE at top = mgh = [M] × 10 × [H] = [RESULT] J

templates.pattern: A machine has a power output of [P] W and an efficiency of [EFF]%. What is its power input?
templates.explanation: Efficiency = Power Output ÷ Power Input × 100 → Power Input = Power Output × 100 ÷ Efficiency = [P] × 100 ÷ [EFF] = [RESULT] W

templates.pattern: A [P] W light bulb is left on for [T] seconds. How much energy is wasted as heat if it is only [EFF]% efficient?
templates.explanation: Total energy = [P] × [T] = [P*T] J. Wasted energy = Total × (1 − efficiency) = [P*T] × (1 − [EFF]/100) = [RESULT] J

templates.pattern: A crane lifts a [M] kg load to a height of [H] m in [T] seconds. What is the useful power output of the crane? (g = 10 m/s²)
